title: Micrograph Figure Kit
description: Micrograph Figure Kit is a single-file, offline browser application for preparing microscope images for publication. It detects and reads scale bars, adds new scale bars, panel letters, text, arrows and shapes, supports measurements and EDS map layouts, and composes multi-panel figures with export to PNG, TIFF and editable SVG. All processing runs locally in the browser; no data is sent to external servers. The interface is available in English and Russian.
